title: [Claude] upload_vita does not push assets/emoji, so a fresh VPK install is needed before emoji show
body:
## Problem
#91 adds Twemoji PNGs under the app's `assets/emoji`, shipped inside the VPK. The `upload_vita` CMake target (eboot over FTP for quick iteration) only uploads the binary, so after a code-only upload a device without a prior full VPK install renders emoji as missing. Noted by the #91 agent.

## Fix
Make `upload_vita` also sync the assets directory (or document that the VPK must be installed once after asset changes) and mention it in the `vitadeck-build` skill.

Posted by Claude Code [claude-fable-5-1]
